promptTemplates.title: Distributed System Concurrency & Consensus
promptTemplates.description: Compare Raft, Paxos, and Vector Clocks under high-network partition scenarios.
promptTemplates.prompt: Compare Raft, Multi-Paxos, and Vector Clocks in a globally distributed database with high cross-region latency and frequent network partitions. Address: 1. Failure detection latency, 2. Split-brain prevention, 3. Read throughput tradeoffs under linearizable vs casual consistency. Provide concrete architectural diagrams or ASCII flows.

promptTemplates.title: Zero-Allocation TypeScript Parsing Algorithm
promptTemplates.description: Write an optimized streaming token parser in TypeScript with zero buffer reallocations.
promptTemplates.prompt: Write an optimized token scanner in TypeScript for a nested JSON/JSONL stream that operates on an ArrayBuffer with zero heap memory allocations during parsing. Include benchmarks, byte offset traversal, and handle UTF-8 multi-byte boundary cases gracefully.

promptTemplates.title: Quantum Computing vs RSA Cryptography

promptTemplates.title: Factual Accuracy: Microprocessor Vulnerabilities
promptTemplates.description: Compare Meltdown, Spectre v1/v2, and Downfall across Intel, AMD, and ARM architectures.
promptTemplates.prompt: Detail the hardware transient execution mechanics behind Spectre (v1 bounds check bypass, v2 branch target injection), Meltdown (rogue data cache load), and Downfall (gather instruction leak). Which CPU generations of Intel, AMD, and ARM were vulnerable, and what was the measured performance cost of hardware vs OS microcode mitigations?
